newsitem.title: USA: CIPSCO says results pressured by weather.
newsitem.headline: CIPSCO says results pressured by weather.

text.p: CIPSCO Inc said Wednesday its earnings for the second quarter were hurt by weather and special items.
Earlier the company said it earned $12.2 million, or $0.36 a share, compared to $12.0 million, or $0.35 a share, in the second quarter of 1996.
The nearly flat quarterly earnings were a result of an unusual weather pattern during the period, Clifford Greenwalt, president and chief executive officer, said in a statement.

At the start of the quarter, electric and gas sales for space heating benefited from colder-than-normal weather, he said. The cooler weather, which continued into May and June, had the reverse effect on sales during the last half of the quarter because air conditioning load was lower than normal.

Also, unusual costs associated with corporate restructuring and the proposed merger with Union Electric Co were $0.05 a share during the quarter compared to $0.03 a share during the second quarter of 1996.
